# sigma_organization_settings (Resource)

Singleton resource managing a Sigma organization's settings. Each block is independently optional so a subset can be adopted piecemeal; unconfigured blocks reflect the organization's current values instead of erroring or drifting. Deleting this resource only removes it from Terraform state — Sigma has no API to delete or reset organization settings, so the org's actual settings are left exactly as last applied.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage a subset of org-wide settings. Unconfigured blocks (csv_upload and
# license_upgrade_requests here) are left untouched — Terraform reflects
# Sigma's current value for them instead of erroring or drifting, so you can
# adopt settings piecemeal.
resource "sigma_organization_settings" "this" {
  timezone = {
    timezone = "America/Los_Angeles"
  }

  comments = {
    enabled                   = true
    allow_annotations         = true
    annotation_retention_days = 365
  }

  audit_logging = {
    enabled = true
  }

  bulk_copy = {
    enabled = false
  }

  public_embeds = {
    enabled = false
  }

  sample_connections = {
    enable_snowflake  = false
    enable_databricks = false
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `ai_chat_history` (Attributes) Sigma AI chat history retention. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_chat_history))
- `audit_logging` (Attributes) Organization audit logging. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit_logging))
- `bulk_copy` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bulk_copy))
- `comments` (Attributes) Commenting on documents. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--comments))
- `csv_upload` (Attributes) CSV file upload. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--csv_upload))
- `email_branding` (Attributes) Branding for outgoing emails. Sigma also exposes a DELETE on this endpoint to reset it; this resource doesn't call it, consistent with the resource having no delete/reset semantics overall. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_branding))
- `license_upgrade_requests` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--license_upgrade_requests))
- `public_embeds` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public_embeds))
- `sample_connections` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sample_connections))
- `timezone` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timezone))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--ai_chat_history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_chat_history`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `retention_period` (String) Days a chat conversation is kept: `30`, `60`, `90`, or `never`. Null if no retention period is configured.


<a id="nestedatt--audit_logging"></a>
### Nested Schema for `audit_logging`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean)

Read-Only:

- `status` (String) Raw server status: `enabled`, `enable_in_progress`, `disabled`, or `disable_in_progress`. `enable_in_progress`/`disable_in_progress` mean a background task is still converging.


<a id="nestedatt--bulk_copy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bulk_copy`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether bulk-copy is enabled for the organization.


<a id="nestedatt--comments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `comments`

Optional:

- `allow_annotations` (Boolean) Whether users can capture images and annotate them in comments. Only takes effect when `enabled` is true.
- `annotation_retention_days` (Number) How long annotation images are kept, in days. Must be between 1 and 730.
- `enabled` (Boolean)


<a id="nestedatt--csv_upload"></a>
### Nested Schema for `csv_upload`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `increase_upload_limit` (Boolean) Whether the CSV upload size limit is increased for the organization.
- `use_internal_stages` (Boolean) Whether CSV uploads use Snowflake internal stages. Requires an active Snowflake connection.
- `use_storage_integration` (Boolean) Whether CSV uploads use the organization's external storage integration instead of Sigma-managed storage.


<a id="nestedatt--email_branding"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_branding`

Optional:

- `display_name` (String) Sender display name on outgoing branded emails.
- `footer_body` (String) Footer text appended to outgoing branded emails.
- `global_bcc_addresses` (List of String) Addresses BCC'd on every outgoing branded email.
- `hide_sender_info` (Boolean) Whether to hide the sender's name and email address on outgoing branded emails.
- `reply_to_address` (String) Reply-to address for outgoing branded emails. Null if no override is configured.
- `signature_name` (String) Name shown in the signature block of outgoing branded emails.


<a id="nestedatt--license_upgrade_requests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `license_upgrade_requests`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether members can request license upgrades.


<a id="nestedatt--public_embeds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `public_embeds`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether public embeds are enabled for the organization.


<a id="nestedatt--sample_connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sample_connections`

Optional:

- `enable_databricks` (Boolean) Enable the Databricks sample connection, if one exists for the organization.
- `enable_snowflake` (Boolean) Enable the Snowflake sample connection, if one exists for the organization.


<a id="nestedatt--timezone"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timezone`

Optional:

- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone identifier for the organization, e.g. `America/Los_Angeles`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: one settings object per organization.
terraform import sigma_organization_settings.example organization
```
